definitions.gloss: redness; erythema; reddening of the skin
definitions.explanation: Abnormal redness of the skin caused by inflammation, irritation, allergy, or infection. A medical term used in clinical descriptions and pharmaceutical instructions.

examples.japanese: {注射|ちゅうしゃ}{部位|ぶい}に{発赤|ほっせき}が{見|み}られる。
examples.english: Redness can be seen at the injection site.

examples.japanese: {発赤|ほっせき}や{腫|は}れがあれば{医師|いし}に{相談|そうだん}してください。
examples.english: If you notice redness or swelling, please consult a doctor.

examples.japanese: アレルギー{反応|はんのう}で{皮膚|ひふ}に{発赤|ほっせき}と{痒|かゆ}みが{出|で}た。
examples.english: An allergic reaction caused redness and itching on the skin.

notes: A medical term frequently seen in clinical reports, drug information leaflets, and patient instructions. Often listed alongside other symptoms like {腫脹|しゅちょう} (swelling), {疼痛|とうつう} (pain), and {発熱|はつねつ} (fever). Common collocations: {発赤|ほっせき}が{見|み}られる (redness is observed), {発赤|ほっせき}を{伴|ともな}う (accompanied by redness). In everyday language, {赤|あか}み (redness) or {赤|あか}くなる (to become red) are more common.
